# Kenney Animated Characters Protagonists — source record

- Official URL: https://kenney.nl/assets/animated-characters-protagonists
- Downloaded: 2026-11-06
- Licence: CC0-1.0 (see `LICENSE.txt`, unmodified from the pack)
- Used source files: `Model/characterMedium.fbx`, `Animations/idle.fbx`, and
  `Animations/run.fbx`.
- Runtime GLB conversion: FBX2glTF 0.9.7-p1, binary glTF 2.0. The runtime
